description: Candidates with available_stock <= 0 must be excluded from actionable offers to prevent fulfillment failures.
Products with unverified or missing inventory status must never be assumed available; excluded by fail-safe.
Candidates with gross profit margin strictly below 10% (0.10) cannot support recommendation discounts.
When customer context is reward point redemption, product must have reward_eligible == True.
Offers requiring standard express promise cannot have estimated shipping_days > 7.
Product must be flagged promotion_eligible == True to appear in targeted campaigns.
Products with product_status not equal to 'active' must be excluded.
